scope: Finite-temperature common-noise holds in the 128-site four-periodic fixed-cubic cell of density 2, thermal energy 0.008, cutoff 2.5. Deformed cells are rectangular with side lengths prescribed by the drive. The new disordered runs reuse the original native force evaluator. Paired coarse and fine noise across resolutions uses a Brownian bridge. Rotation/shape relaxation, different thermal histories and other shear generators are outside these warm holds.

steps.fine: two equal steps per coarse interval with the same net noise
steps.preparation: separate 1-transit burn-in on the fixed cubic cold endpoint at each resolution
steps.readout: 1 downstream transit; final quarter is frames 37-48 inclusive; compare central differences at ±0.0001 and ±0.00005 for first shear. Quench diagnostics call the original fixed-box equilibrium solver.
